body.name: Explicit legal two-parameter collision family and sequence specialization
body.construction:
Fix \(K=3\), \(T=5\), \(g=0\), \(r=1\), the binary alphabet \(\mathcal Y=\{0,1\}\) ordered as \(0<1\), and the coding \(\nu(0)=0\), \(\nu(1)=1\). Fix the chart \(\mathcal U=(\epsilon,0,1)\) and \(\mathcal V=((\epsilon,R),(\epsilon,A),(0,A))\). Under the baseline-symbol convention in \(\mathcal D_{K-1}\), fix \(\mathcal D_2=(I_3,\bar B_1,\bar B_1^2)\), \(\mathcal F=(I_3,\bar B_1)\), and \(d=2\). For local parameters \(\eta,\zeta\ge0\), put
\[
 h^{(0)}(\eta)=\left(\frac3{20}-\eta,\frac3{20}+\eta,\frac9{20}\right)^{\!\top},\qquad
 B_1^{\star}(\zeta)=\operatorname{diag}\left(\frac15,\frac15+\zeta,\frac45\right),\qquad
 B_0^{\star}(\zeta)=I_3-B_1^{\star}(\zeta),
\]
and define
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \alpha^{(0)}&=\alpha_{\star},& P^{(0)}&=P_{\star},&
 K_0^{(0)}(\eta)&=\{I_3-\operatorname{diag}(h^{(0)}(\eta))\}P_{\star},\\
 \alpha^{(1)}&=\alpha_{\star}S_{\star},&
 h^{(1)}(\eta)&=S_{\star}^{-1}h^{(0)}(\eta),&
 K_0^{(1)}(\eta)&=S_{\star}^{-1}K_0^{(0)}(\eta)S_{\star},\\
 &&P^{(1)}(\eta)&=\{I_3-\operatorname{diag}(h^{(1)}(\eta))\}^{-1}K_0^{(1)}(\eta).&&
 \end{aligned}
\]
Let \(P_j^{\eta,\zeta}\), \(j\in\{0,1\}\), be the six-date stopped-panel law induced by \(\alpha^{(j)},P^{(j)}(\eta),h^{(j)}(\eta),B_0^{\star}(\zeta),B_1^{\star}(\zeta)\), where \(P^{(0)}(\eta)=P_{\star}\), and by one common deterministic treated-outcome law. The two-parameter positive family is \(\mathfrak C(\eta,\zeta)=(P_0^{\eta,\zeta},P_1^{\eta,\zeta})\). Its declared sequence specialization is \(\mathfrak C_N=\mathfrak C(\eta_N,\zeta_N)\), where \(\eta_N=N^{-1/4}\) and \(\zeta_N=N^{-1}\); thus its members are the already declared \(P_{W,N}^{(0)}\) and \(P_{W,N}^{(1)}\). Evaluate the causal target only at \(\mu^0_{0,1}\) and \(\tau_{0,1}\).
